questions.question: What do I need to do today?
questions.answer: Today shows only your assigned visits, travel windows, incomplete notes and follow-ups.

questions.question: Who is my next client and when should I arrive?
questions.answer: The next visit card shows the client, service, local start time, duration and assigned provider.

questions.question: Where do I find the address and entry instructions?
questions.answer: Open your assigned visit. Live access must be limited to authorized visit details; the preview uses fictional locations.

questions.question: How do I know a shift changed or was cancelled?
questions.answer: A change notice stays in the inbox until you acknowledge it. Cancelled work does not count as worked hours.

questions.question: How do I accept or decline an assigned visit?
questions.answer: Acknowledge an approved assignment, or report an availability issue with a reason. Requesting cover does not silently remove your assignment.

questions.question: What if I am late or cannot attend?
questions.answer: Use Report a delay / coverage issue. The request remains visible until scheduling confirms the replacement.

questions.question: Where is the current plan of care?
questions.answer: Open the visit and read the assigned plan version before accepting care tasks.

questions.question: What may I do as a PSW?
questions.answer: Follow assigned support tasks, your training and employer policy. An app checklist does not authorize controlled acts or medication administration.

questions.question: What if the plan, consent or clearance is missing?
questions.answer: The visit shows a readiness blocker. Contact the responsible supervisor; the dashboard does not invent clearance or consent.

questions.question: How do I start and finish a visit?
questions.answer: Confirm consent, start the visit record, record every task outcome and factual notes, then submit your visit and reported time.

questions.question: What if the client declines a task?
questions.answer: Choose Declined, record the choice and notify the responsible team where follow-up is required.

questions.question: What if a task cannot be completed?
questions.answer: Choose Held / needs review and explain the unresolved issue. Do not mark the task completed.

questions.question: What happens if the client is not home?
questions.answer: Report no access, document attempts without guessing care occurred, and request direction. Time eligibility depends on reviewed evidence and policy.

questions.question: What if I see a safety concern or emergency?
questions.answer: Follow the organization emergency process. For immediate danger contact emergency services directly; saving a concern does not send an emergency response.

questions.question: Can I correct a submitted note?
questions.answer: Keep the original record. Use an amendment or returned-note correction with an explanation and review history.

questions.question: How do I know my visit was reviewed?
questions.answer: The visit status distinguishes submitted, returned for correction and independently reviewed.

questions.question: How many hours have I worked today?
questions.answer: Today sums reported actual minutes less recorded unpaid breaks. Planned duration is displayed separately.

questions.question: How many hours have I worked this week?
questions.answer: The weekly ledger shows each dated time record and calculates reported, awaiting-review, returned and approved totals.

questions.question: Are scheduled hours guaranteed paid hours?
questions.answer: No. Scheduled, reported, approved and payroll-confirmed hours are separate states.

questions.question: How are breaks handled?
questions.answer: Record the actual break in minutes. This preview subtracts recorded unpaid breaks from gross work time; live policy must define paid breaks.

questions.question: Does travel time count?
questions.answer: Travel and mileage need their own evidence and employer policy. This preview does not add them to approved hours.

questions.question: What if I forget to clock in or out?
questions.answer: Submit a correction with actual times and a reason; it awaits independent review rather than changing a clock record silently.

questions.question: Can I edit approved hours?
questions.answer: Request a correction. Preserve the original approved record and review history.

questions.question: Why are some hours not approved?
questions.answer: The ledger shows the status and reviewer reason. Returned records stay separate from approved hours.

questions.question: Can I export my weekly time record?
questions.answer: Export CSV includes visit, date, gross minutes, break minutes, net hours, review status and reason.

questions.question: Can I see previous weeks?
questions.answer: Use the week selector; totals are calculated for the selected week, including a clear empty state.

questions.question: How do I get more hours?
questions.answer: Publish availability and request eligible open visits. A request is not an assignment or a guaranteed shift.

questions.question: What is my weekly target?
questions.answer: Set a personal availability goal. The dashboard shows scheduled hours and the gap without promising income.

questions.question: What is my hourly rate?
questions.answer: Show only a confirmed employment or contractor rate and its effective date. No authoritative employment rate is currently connected.

questions.question: How much will I be paid?
questions.answer: Show a confirmed payroll statement when a payroll integration exists. Approved care time alone is not proof of wages paid.

questions.question: When is payday?
questions.answer: Display the employer-confirmed pay cycle and statement. No employer-confirmed payday is connected.

questions.question: How do I claim mileage or an expense?
questions.answer: Submit the date, category, amount or distance and evidence; an authorized reviewer decides eligibility.

questions.question: What if my hours or pay are wrong?
questions.answer: Raise a dated query linked to the time record or statement, with a reason and visible resolution status.

questions.question: How do I tell the team when I can work?
questions.answer: Save available days, start/end time and preferred area. Live scheduling still checks skills, clearance and conflicts.

questions.question: How do I request time off?
questions.answer: Submit dated leave with a reason. It stays pending until reviewed; assigned visits still need coverage.

questions.question: Can I reject work outside my availability?
questions.answer: Report the mismatch and request scheduling review. Do not assume the client has been reassigned.

questions.question: Can I request a nearby open visit?
questions.answer: View eligible opportunities and request one. Only an authorized scheduler can confirm the assignment.

questions.question: Who is my supervisor or coordinator?
questions.answer: Show the actual assigned care-team contacts in live records. Demo names are fictional. Live care-team details come from the assigned record.

questions.question: How do I send a handover?
questions.answer: Save a factual handover linked to the visit and intended team member. Live review and delivery status must be shown.

questions.question: Did somebody receive my message?
questions.answer: Distinguish saved, delivered and acknowledged. Team requests save to the tenant operations queue. External delivery is not assumed; clinical handovers use the assigned care record.

questions.question: Where do I find unresolved concerns?
questions.answer: The inbox and action list show open requests with an owner, status and follow-up date.

questions.question: What training or documents do I need?
questions.answer: The readiness panel shows verified requirements, expiry and missing evidence. Sample statuses are not real credential checks.

questions.question: What happens when a document expires?
questions.answer: Flag the expiry and show affected work as a blocker until authorized verification is complete.

questions.question: Who can see my information?
questions.answer: Live access must use the existing tenant, role and assigned-care restrictions. Code administration is not clinical permission.

questions.question: What if my connection fails?
questions.answer: Show unsaved work explicitly. Changes save through the session API to PostgreSQL. Failed or conflicting saves show an error and restore the previous saved state.

questions.question: How do I sign in, verify my phone or get help?
questions.answer: Use the existing account security flow. A PSW dashboard must show the account verification result and a support route without faking an OTP.

questions.question: How do I learn this as a new PSW?
questions.answer: Follow Prepare → Visit → Document → Report time → Review. The guided checklist links to the exact screen.

questions.question: What is still waiting on me?
questions.answer: Action cards list incomplete tasks, returned notes, time corrections and messages requiring acknowledgement.

questions.question: Can I see the history of my changes?
questions.answer: The database activity log records actor, timestamp, action and record reference. Clinical and time changes retain their existing immutable care-event histories.

questions.question: How are screens and workflows registered?
questions.answer: The implementation map links every question to a task, screen code and workflow code. The release registers the personal screens, controls, API schemas, role grants and source-mapped workflow journeys in the production governance database.

Accept, consent, start, tasks, note submission and amendments
Attested time submission and independent approval or return

integrationConstraints: Extend shared care clients and base session client instead of duplicating clinical rules.
Read and register production governance; do not use a local SQLite fallback as production authority.
Match existing screen codes and registry IDs before adding new entries.
Do not claim payroll, credential checks, notifications or clinical approval when their authoritative service has not confirmed them.

apiConstraints.liveClinicalWrites: Use existing care contracts; personal endpoint refuses clinical/demo mutation actions in live mode.
apiConstraints.demoCleanup: Only the selected marked personal workspace and its synthetic retry responses; live records and audit history preserved.
apiConstraints.review: Tenant operations only; own requests cannot be reviewed; review does not assign staff, authorize care, approve time or release payroll.
